name: business-agent-os
description: Set up a business operating system for Claude Code on a Mac, for business owners who are not developers: one folder of plain-text memory (a folder per client and project, notes, a daily log, a voice guide), /pickup, /wrap, /biz-status and /new-client commands, local save points and an optional tmux session menu. One skill plus a read-only MCP server that returns the templates.
